_comment: Cloud bot: HourlyTrend on Gate.io, dry-run only, no API keys. Gate.io rather than Bybit because Bybit and Binance both refuse GitHub's runners (403 / 451) - see research/make_cloud_config_gate.py. Prices differ from Bybit's by a fraction of a percent on liquid coins, which is acceptable for a paper test. Live trading would still need Bybit.

entry_pricing._comment_price_side: MUST be "other" - this strategy uses freqtrade's default MARKET orders, and a market order crosses the spread. With "same" the dry-run priced entries at the bid and exits at the ask, i.e. it EARNED the spread twice per round trip instead of paying it, flattering the paper account. freqtrade validates this (config_validation._validate_price_config) but only after the strategy is resolved, so 'trade' and 'backtesting' never raised it - 'lookahead-analysis' did. Backtesting is unaffected either way: it fills from candle prices, not the order book.
